title: Usman Khan v. Paschimanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Limited and Another
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Mahesh Chandra Tripathi and Vivek Kumar Singh, JJ.
disposition: Writ dismissed as infructuous after notice withdrawn
headnote: Writ challenging a provisional-assessment demand of Rs 1,88,756 dismissed as infructuous after the licensee withdrew the notice dated 27 June 2021 to give a fresh opportunity. The Court did not examine the assessment. It left the department free to proceed in accordance with law. Counsel stated that any application would be considered under clause 6.14 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005.
facts: Usman Khan filed a writ against Paschimanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Limited to quash a demand notice dated 27 June 2021 for Rs 1,88,756, issued by the Executive Engineer at Milak Panvadiya, and to restrain coercive recovery. He contended that the notice fastened liability only on a provisional assessment. Counsel for the licensee stated that the notice had already been withdrawn to give a fresh opportunity, and that any application the petitioner moved would be considered under clause 6.14 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005.

holding_units.topic: withdrawal of provisional-assessment demand; writ infructuous
holding_units.holding: The writ was dismissed as infructuous once the licensee stated that the demand notice dated 27 June 2021 had already been withdrawn to give the petitioner a fresh opportunity. Counsel added that any application the petitioner moved would be dealt with strictly under clause 6.14 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. The Court did not construe that clause or the provisional assessment, and left the department free to proceed in accordance with law.

principle_tags.application: The challenge to the notice of 27 June 2021 ended when that notice was withdrawn before hearing. Dismissal as infructuous left the provisional assessment and clause 6.14 undecided.

not_decided.point: Legality of the provisional assessment and of the demand of Rs 1,88,756 under the notice dated 27 June 2021.
not_decided.note: The notice was withdrawn and the writ was dismissed as infructuous without a merits decision.

not_decided.point: Scope of clause 6.14 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005, and the relief due if the petitioner moves an application.
not_decided.note: Clause 6.14 appears only in the licensee's statement. The Court did not construe it.
